question: Flask tile it is (round-017 a), now named taste.lab. Same mark everywhere; how should the name be set?

variants.label: Plain
variants.changes: taste.lab in one weight and color, semibold. The quietest.

variants.label: Coral dot
variants.changes: taste.lab semibold with the dot in coral, the second brand color, as a small accent.

variants.label: Muted .lab
variants.changes: "taste" semibold, ".lab" regular and muted, so the name reads taste first.

variants.label: Teal mono .lab
variants.changes: "taste" semibold, ".lab" in teal mono, like a domain or a file extension.
